chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Abdullah b. al-Hasan al-Mu'addab narrated to us from Ahmad b. Ali al-Isfahani from Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Makhul b. Ibrahim informed us. He said: Abd al-Jabbar b. al-Abbas al-Hamadani narrated to us from Ammar b. Abi Mu'awiya al-Dihni from Amira bt. Af'a.

She said: I heard Umm Salama (may Allah be pleased with her) saying: This verse was revealed in my house: "Surely, Allah only wishes to remove uncleanliness from you, O Ahl al-Bayt, and purify you with a thorough purification" [33:33]. She said: There were seven in the house: the Messenger of Allah, Gabriel, Michael, Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn (blessings of Allah upon them). She said: And I was at the door, so I said: O Messenger of Allah! Am I not from Ahl al-Bayt? He said: You are from the wives of the Prophet. And he did not say: You are from Ahl al-Bayt.

key_terms.أهل البيت: Ahl al-Bayt - People of the House, referring specifically to the Prophet, Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan and al-Husayn
key_terms.تطهيرا: Tathira - thorough purification, signifying divine protection from sin

ai.seo_question: What happened when the Verse of Purification (33:33) was revealed according to Umm Salama?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates Umm Salama's account of the revelation of the Verse of Purification (33:33), one of the most significant proofs for the Shia understanding of Ahl al-Bayt. She reports that seven were present when it was revealed: the Prophet, the archangels Gabriel and Michael, Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn. When Umm Salama asked if she too was from Ahl al-Bayt, the Prophet distinguished her as one of his wives rather than Ahl al-Bayt, thereby restricting the term to the Five of the Cloak.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. al-Hasan al-Mu’addab narrated to us from Ahmad b. `Ali al-Isfahani from Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Makhul b. Ibrahim informed us. He said: `Abd al-Jabbar b. al-`Abbas al-Hamadani narrated to us from `Ammar b. Abi Mu`awiya al-Dihni from `Amira bt. Af`a.

She said: I heard Umm Salama (ra) say: This verse was revealed in my house, “Surely, Allah only wishes to remove uncleanliness from you, O Ahl al-Bayt, and purify you with a thorough purification.” [33:33] She said: There were seven people in the house: The Messenger of Allah, Gabriel, Michael, `Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn (as). She said: I was at the door, so I said: O Messenger of Allah! Am I not from Ahl al-Bayt? He said: You are from the wives of the Prophet. He did not say: You are from Ahl al-Bayt.
